description: StockMap's published call on one US stock, the same for every reader, by symbol or company name: the model's nightly 14-day read (a call or a lean), the strongest reasons for and against, how its past calls on the stock did, the price and the day's change, and what changed last night. Use it when someone asks how a US stock looks, whether it reads strong or weak right now, or what the model's read on it is. Each answer carries the not-advice line and the run date.

stock.description: A US stock's symbol (NVDA, BRK.B) or its company name (Nvidia)
stock.title: Stock

name: stock_call

label.description: The call as the stock page's pill names it
label.title: Label

favoured.description: The side of the factor the insight favours
favoured.title: Favoured

label.description: The factor as the insight names it
label.title: Label

short.description: The stock page's short label for it
short.title: Short

stock_side.description: Where this stock sits on it: favoured, against or middle
stock_side.title: Stock Side

close.description: The close of the run's trading day; the run is nightly
close.title: Close

vs_index_pct.description: That day's change less the index's, in points
vs_index_pct.title: Vs Index Pct

base_rate.description: How often the same calls would be right by chance; null before the rule's blocks carry the counts
base_rate.title: Base Rate

checked_at.description: YYYY-MM-DD the rate was last checked (two-week moves)
checked_at.title: Checked At

line.description: The reason in one short line: its strongest factors, as the page's chips read
line.title: Line

right.description: How often the insight has been right beside its base rate, as the page says it; empty when it has no accuracy
right.title: Right

scope.description: stock, industry or sector: what the insight is graded against
scope.title: Scope

chance.description: What a random call on the same dates scored, a market number (never this stock's percentage); null without a base rate
chance.title: Chance

last_line.description: The last graded call, as a sentence
last_line.title: Last Line

line.description: The record line alone: 'Right in h of k two-week windows on SYM since ... (as of ...).', or the too-few line
line.title: Line

text.description: The model's record on this stock, as the stock page says it: the counts of two-week windows and the chance line, or the too-few line
text.title: Text

too_few.description: True: too few two-week windows graded to judge yet, so no record is given
too_few.title: Too Few

not_landed.description: True: tonight's run has not landed yet, so this is the previous run
not_landed.title: Not Landed

lean.description: The sector's own 2-week lean, −100 to +100, the number market_map and sector give for the same run; None when that feed is on another run
lean.title: Lean

net.description: This stock against its sector: the mean read of the page's sector insights on it, −100 to +100 (the page's sector scale). Not the sector's own lean
net.title: Net

closest.description: The stocks the query may have meant
closest.title: Closest

not_advice.default: The model's track-recorded read, not financial advice.
not_advice.title: Not Advice

stock.description: None when no one stock matched

title: Stock call
